verdict.rationale: Mercury provides an official, documented, remote MCP server at https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp with OAuth2-gated access, verified live via probe returning proper auth challenges and OAuth discovery metadata, plus a documented inventory of 31 read-only tools covering accounts, transactions, cards, invoices, and more. This is a first-party, production MCP integration, though currently limited to read-only operations rather than full read/write agent control.
